shared_elements: small subsidiary figures scattered around a larger motif
justification: Both surfaces show schematic human figures, and in each there is at least one figure with arms raised, but that is a near-universal motif; A depicts a modelled relief scene of profile figures with elaborate headdresses, offering tables and vessels beneath a canopy, whereas B shows stick-figure line drawings dominated by curved crewed boats with rows of vertical strokes, a motif entirely absent from A. The proportions and conventions differ sharply: A uses naturalistic bodies in profile with detailed costume and infilled forms, B uses thin linear outlines with no interior detail, so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
